summary: No operator website or booking engine: the website field is an unclaimed RoverPass directory listing; Google Maps 'Wishing Well RV Campground' (4.6 / 41 reviews, phone matches) meets the presence rule. Cleared the aggregator-only hookups, site count, laundry and dump (note now says directory listings describe them). No 2024+ operator rate; price only the RV Life $$ tier. No gateway within 40 km (Myrtle Beach 45 km); family has not stayed here.
flags: Website is an unclaimed RoverPass listing ('Claim my Campground', 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024'), not bookable and not the operator's: remove the link. No operator site exists that I could find.

Presence: passes on Google Maps - 'Wishing Well RV Campground', 520 Seaside Rd SW, Sunset Beach, 4.6 stars over 41 reviews, phone (910) 579-7982 (matches the entry), no website. Price rests only on the RV Life $$ tier; no posted nightly rate. A Google review snippet calls it 'Great place to park if you're in town for work' - a hint of a workforce clientele, though another speaks of a reasonable price for a visit; the share is not determinable.

Name: Google lists it as 'Wishing Well RV Campground'. AllStays (aggregator) gives 15 sites with 10 water/electric and a 40-ft max, against the note's ~34 full-hookup sites; no operator page settles it, so the derived count was cleared with the other directory-only values.

hookups.source: No operator page exists (website field is an unclaimed RoverPass directory listing, read 2026-10-22; Google Maps lists no website). The stored 30 A / water / sewer were derived from note prose that rests only on directory listings, so they are cleared.

sites.source: Same as hookups: the ~34-site count rests only on directory listings (AllStays says 15); no operator page exists (read 2026-10-22).

facilities.source: Same as hookups: laundry and dump station rest only on the unclaimed RoverPass listing's amenity tags; no operator page exists (read 2026-10-22).

note: Small family campground on Seaside Rd SW (NC 904), about 10 minutes from Sunset Beach and Ocean Isle. Directory listings (not the operator) describe shaded and open RV/tent sites with water/electric or full hookups, showers, a dump station and laundry. No website of its own; phone from its Google listing. --Claude
